title: LabLite-CVD: explainable, tiered-input cardiovascular risk model quantifying the information cost of missing laboratory data
description: Explainable, tiered-input model for 10-year risk of cardiovascular death (non-CVD death as a competing event), developed on NHANES 1999-2010 with NCHS 2019 public-use linked mortality. Four nested tiers (office measures; + lipids; + HbA1c and eGFR; + urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio) of ridge-penalized cause-specific Cox models with restricted cubic splines quantify the information cost of missing laboratory data in discrimination, calibration, net benefit and reclassification, with survey-weighted IPCW evaluation and Rao-Wu bootstrap. Includes data download, cohort construction, model fitting, model card and a Python package (PyPI: lablite-cvd). Research use only; not a medical device.
